Scenario: Verify login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter valid username; 3. Enter valid password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: User authenticated and redirected to /dashboard/index
Actual Result: Redirected to Dashboard URL; user profile and quick access widgets displayed

Scenario: Verify login attempt with invalid password
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter valid username; 3. Enter incorrect password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: System denies access and displays error banner: 'Invalid credentials'
Actual Result: Error alert banner with text 'Invalid credentials' displayed

Scenario: Verify login attempt with non-existent username
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter invalid username; 3. Enter valid password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: System denies access and displays error banner: 'Invalid credentials'
Actual Result: Error alert banner 'Invalid credentials' displayed as expected

Scenario: Verify validation when submitting empty fields
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Leave Username blank; 3. Leave Password blank; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Form not submitted. Red validation error 'Required' displayed beneath both fields
Actual Result: Both fields display red outline and inline validation text 'Required'

Scenario: Verify validation when username entered but password blank
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter valid username; 3. Leave Password blank; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Form not submitted. Red validation error 'Required' displayed beneath Password field only
Actual Result: Inline error 'Required' displayed under Password field

Scenario: Verify validation when password entered but username blank
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Leave Username blank; 3. Enter valid password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Form not submitted. Red validation error 'Required' displayed beneath Username field only
Actual Result: Inline error 'Required' displayed under Username field

Scenario: Verify password field masking and security
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter password text; 3. Inspect character presentation and DOM element
Expected Result: Password characters masked as bullets/dots (type='password') to prevent shoulder surfing
Actual Result: Password field attribute type='password' masks characters properly

Scenario: Verify Password case sensitivity handling
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter valid username; 3. Enter password in UPPERCASE; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Authentication fails due to case-sensitive password hash check; displays 'Invalid credentials'
Actual Result: System displayed 'Invalid credentials'. Case sensitivity enforced

Scenario: Verify SQL Injection resiliency in login fields
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Enter SQL payload in username field; 3. Enter dummy password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Input is sanitized or safely parameterized; login fails with 'Invalid credentials' without DB error
Actual Result: Input handled safely; error banner 'Invalid credentials' displayed

Scenario: Verify navigation to Forgot Password page
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Click 'Forgot your password?' link; 3. Check URL and reset form
Expected Result: User redirected to /auth/requestPasswordResetCode with username input and Reset button
Actual Result: Redirected to requestPasswordResetCode page successfully

Scenario: Verify session termination on Logout
Test Steps: 1. Log in with valid credentials; 2. Click User dropdown; 3. Click Logout; 4. Click browser Back button
Expected Result: User redirected to login page; browser back button does not restore authenticated session
Actual Result: User logged out; browser back button redirects back to /auth/login (session cleared)

Scenario: Verify direct access to dashboard without authentication
Test Steps: 1. Clear cookies/open incognito window; 2. Directly navigate to URL: /web/index.php/dashboard/index
Expected Result: Route guard intercepts unauthenticated request and redirects user to /web/index.php/auth/login
Actual Result: User immediately redirected to /auth/login

Scenario: Verify navigation to PIM module via sidebar hover and click
Test Steps: 1. Log into OrangeHRM; 2. Mouse hover over 'PIM' in sidebar; 3. Click 'PIM'
Expected Result: PIM module loads; URL contains /pim/viewEmployeeList; topbar tabs displayed
Actual Result: Navigated to PIM Employee List page successfully

Scenario: Verify adding new employee with mandatory fields
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to PIM > Add Employee; 2. Enter First and Last Name; 3. Click Save
Expected Result: System creates record
Actual Result: displays 'Successfully Saved' toast

Scenario: Verify adding batch of multiple employees (3-4 employees)
Test Steps: 1. Click Add Employee; 2. Enter details for Employees 1-4; 3. Click Save for each
Expected Result: All 4 employees successfully persisted with unique IDs generated
Actual Result: All 4 employee profiles created and saved successfully

Scenario: Verify newly added employee is listed and located in Employee List
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Employee List tab; 2. Filter by Employee ID / Name; 3. Locate employee row
Expected Result: Employee record displayed in table with matching ID
Actual Result: First Name
column9: Located employee in list; verified name and printed 'Name Verified'

Scenario: Verify smooth scrolling and row location in Employee List
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Employee List; 2. Scroll down table viewport; 3. View records across table cards
Expected Result: Table cards scroll smoothly into view without layout shift or UI flickering
Actual Result: Smooth scroll executed cleanly via automated JavaScript script

Scenario: Verify updating employee personal details
Test Steps: 1. Open Employee Personal Details; 2. Modify Nickname or Nationality; 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Success notification displayed; updated fields persist on page reload
Actual Result: Changes saved successfully and verified upon navigating back

Scenario: Verify deleting an individual employee with confirmation modal
Test Steps: 1. Search target employee; 2. Click trash bin icon in Actions column; 3. Click 'Yes, Delete' in modal
Expected Result: Confirmation modal warns user; on confirmation record deleted; table refreshes
Actual Result: Record deleted; subsequent search returns 'No Records Found'

Scenario: Verify cancelling employee deletion does not remove record
Test Steps: 1. In Employee List click trash bin icon; 2. Click 'No, Cancel' in confirmation dialog
Expected Result: Modal closes; employee record remains intact in the list
Actual Result: Deletion aborted; employee remains visible in table
